title: Keto Salmon Fish Soup
description: A creamy, sweet fish soup made with salmon and Vietnamese flavors, perfect for a keto diet.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add the fish sauce, coconut cream, and sweet chili sauce. Stir to combine.
Add the salmon fillet to the pot and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the salmon from the pot and chop it into small pieces.
Return the salmon pieces to the pot and stir to combine with the soup.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with chopped cilantro and sliced green onion.
